newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PT&T says Q3 revenues at 493.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PT&T says Q3 revenues at 493.9 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine Telegraph & Telephone Corp said on Tuesday revenues rose 28 percent to 493.9 million pesos during the three months ending March 31.
The telecommunication company operates on a fiscal year basis beginning July 1.
It attributed the rise to its new local exchange carrier (LEC) service and increasing domestic long distance traffic.
"However, the company has to bear with financial charges brought about by borrowings incurred for the various capital expenditures projects, including the LEC," the company said in a statement.
Net income figures were not immediately available.
